item.title: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch UAV strikes
item.description: ❗️ Today, during the daytime, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued to launch UAV strikes against logistics centres and port infrastructure facilities, as well as vessels used to deliver military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strike, in the city of Chernigov, the Aviation New Technologies LLC transport-logistical centre, which territory was used store military materiel, UAVs and their components, as well as dual-use cargo intended to support the AFU, was hit. 🔥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering cargoes to the port of Odessa to support the AFU was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation – First Deputy Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation General of the Army Valery Gerasimov
item.description: 💬 Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation – First Deputy Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation General of the Army Valery Gerasimov ’In relation to the conduct of a humanitarian operation in the area of the settlement of Aleshki, Kherson region, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation are ceasing fire on the Kherson direction and introducing a 'silence regime' from 04:00 Moscow time on 27 October 2026. In order to ensure the safety of the population and the delivery of socially important cargo, engineer reconnaissance and safe movement of the humanitarian convoy to the settlement of Aleshki, Kherson region, will be organised and ensured’. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⏱️ Waiting in wings is what matters most in assault When the entire group's advance is at stake,
item.description: Waiting in wings is what matters most in assault ⏱️ When the entire group's advance is at stake, it is necessary to act wisely. During the liberation of Mirovka , the servicemen had to perform a ruse: ‘We moved in groups of three, the distance was great. Enemy drones were working along the way, somewhere we had to spend the night in forest belts. We reached assigned positions. There were two small strongholds. As soon as night was coming, we mopped up and established control over them, so that other Russian assaultmen could advance.’ ▫️ As a result of cohesive actions, the assault detachments established control over a powerful defensive area more than 10 square kilometres, including Mirovka itself. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.description: Worse than wild beasts: AFU soldiers finished their wounded comrades 👉 The reconnaissance drone operator of the 80th Guards Tank Regiment (the Tsentr Group of Forces) witnessed Ukrainian servicemen shooting down their own wounded brother-in-arms, unwilling to provide medical assistance and evacuate him. item.title: ‘ We entered carefully. The most important in our work is personnel’. The Tsentr Group's assault detachments told about the
item.description: ‘ We entered carefully. The most important in our work is personnel’. 💬 The Tsentr Group's assault detachments told about the liberation of Pervomayskoye in the Donetsk People's Republic. 👊 The enemy clinged to every metre but Russian lads knocked him out, mopping up every house one after another. Now the way is open. ‘For someone, it's just an area but for us, every settlement means sleepless nights, wounds, and taking care of each other. We entered carefully, The most important in our work is personnel,’ told the company's deputy commander with the call sign ‘Chip’. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ 270 Russian servicemen returned from Kiev regime's territory In exchange, 270 AFU prisoners of war were transferred.
item.description: ❗️ 270 Russian servicemen returned from Kiev regime's territory In exchange, 270 AFU prisoners of war were transferred. Currently, the returned Russian servicemen are on the territory of the Republic of Belarus. Yana Lantratova, the Commissioner for Human Rights in Russia, is working with them. Upon receiving first aid and psychological assistance, all the released servicemen will be sent to the Russian Federation for treatment and rehabilitation at medical institutions of the Russian Ministry of Defence. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
